title: review.triage input
description: Operator triage workflow for conflict artifacts written by map.apply. Loads the artifact at conflictArtifactPath, applies the supplied decisions[], mutates the artifact additively (resolution_status / resolved_at / resolved_by / operator_reason), and routes accept/patch verdicts through map.create / map.update.

conflictArtifactPath.description: Project-relative path to the conflict artifact JSON. Absolute paths, parent-directory traversal (..), and paths escaping the project root are rejected.

projectRoot.description: Optional override for the project root used to resolve conflictArtifactPath. Defaults to process.cwd().

apply.description: When false, accept/patch verdicts route through map.create/map.update with apply=false (dry-run). Default true: review.triage exists to persist decisions.

objectId.description: Identifies the conflict / belowConfidence item to act on (matches conflicts[].objectId or belowConfidence[].objectId).

verdict.description: accept = map.create with recommended traits; patch = map.update existing mapping (optionally merging patchOverrides + decision.reason as notes); defer = mark deferred without calling map.*; dismiss = mark dismissed without calling map.*

reason.description: Optional operator reason. Surfaces as operator_reason on the artifact item and (for accept/patch) as map.* metadata.notes.

resolvedBy.description: Optional operator/agent identifier recorded on the artifact item as resolved_by. Defaults to 'review.triage'.

patchOverrides.description: Optional partial map.update updates object. Merged on top of the candidate.recommended_oods_traits + projection_variants payload for patch verdicts.
